title: Echo Caverns: Aerial Traversal

foundation.history: A forgotten underground listening post once protected acoustic reflectors, until recurring unstable resonance forced residents to abandon it.

premise: Daro Bryn, a pilot, must deliver emergency medicine, relying on wind-aware movement despite unstable resonance.
central_conflict: a disrupted air network threatens the underground listening post by restricting acoustic reflectors.

plot_beats.name: Discovery
plot_beats.cause: unstable resonance destroys the primary approach
plot_beats.effect: The player must choose an alternative entry

plot_beats.name: Competing truths
plot_beats.cause: a disrupted air network contests access to acoustic reflectors
plot_beats.effect: The protagonist must reconcile independent testimony

plot_beats.name: Reconstruction
plot_beats.cause: The underground listening post becomes operable
plot_beats.effect: The choice of stewardship rewrites the alliance map

endings.consequence: Locals create an autonomous stewardship cooperative
Survival is proven but structural inequity remains
